argv:
printf "[UNAME]\n"; uname -a; uname -r; uname -m
printf "[PROC_VERSION]\n"; cat /proc/version
printf "[BOOT_BANNER]\n"; dmesg | grep -m 1 "Linux version"
printf "[OS_RELEASE]\n"; cat /etc/os-release
printf "[DEVICE_MODEL]\n"; tr "\000" "\n" </sys/firmware/devicetree/base/model
printf "[LOCAL_ADDRESS]\n"; ifconfig -a
printf "[KERNEL_NOTES]\n"; sha256sum /sys/kernel/notes; od -An -v -tx1 /sys/kernel/notes
printf "[KDBUS_FILES]\n"; r=$(uname -r); base=/usr/lib/modules/$r
if [ ! -d "$base" ]; then base=/lib/modules/$r; fi
if [ -d "$base" ]; then
  find "$base" -type f \( -name "kdbus.ko" -o -name "kdbus.ko.gz" -o -name "kdbus.ko.xz" -o -name "kdbus.ko.zst" \) -exec sha256sum {} \;
fi
printf "[KDBUS_LOADED]\n"; grep "^kdbus " /proc/modules
printf "[KDBUS_NOTE]\n"; p=/sys/module/kdbus/notes/.note.gnu.build-id
if [ -r "$p" ]; then sha256sum "$p"; od -An -v -tx1 "$p"; fi
printf "[END]\n"
